# submodule　`def.submodule`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=def.submodule)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./def.submodule.md)

⭐ Submodule lattice: any intersection is again a submodule, but a union in general is not; the submodule generated by $S$ is the smallest submodule containing $S$. Quotient modules are built as $M/N$ (see `def.quotient-module`, a later node).

> Proofs of the edges are still Chinese only: `proofs/`; the Chinese page remains authoritative.
